about: Library forms of the 54 new6 and 88 bench-leads questions, written 2026-10-31 from each original question, its expect and the paper's title and pdftotext only, before any answer of this test existed, by the library test's rules: table, figure and section numbers removed; 'the paper', 'the study', 'the review', 'the authors' replaced by a subject phrase; a subject phrase (material, process, system, from the paper's title or the question's own words) added where the question would otherwise fit other papers of a ~120-paper library. No phrase adds a value or a name that the expected answer gives. Answer keys (expect, trap, must) are the originals, unchanged. The 246 cheme / cheme2 questions keep the library test's wording (experiments/library/reworded.json).
